FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreGainDocumentation: Campaign Score points this finding accounts for: its share of the campaign visits that are not clean (a visit with two problems counts half for each). All findings together add up to the points the score misses. Fix the findings with the most points first. Typo hints and fields that do not count towards the score have none.

FeinwerkCampaignScore.FindingsDocumentation: Shows where your campaign values are not clean. A clean value is lowercase and uses only a to z, 0 to 9, underscore, hyphen and full stop. Spelling variants are values that only differ in case, spaces, underscores, hyphens or full stops; the suggestion is the most visited clean variant. A medium is unusual when it is not in the list in the settings. Keywords are only checked for spelling variants, because they often hold search terms. A value shown as "(not set)" is missing in the campaign link; exports and the API give it as an empty value.

You put every report together from building blocks and see in the preview how the email arrives.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginSearchReportText: Search Report imports Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools into native Matomo reports: daily, automatically, with unlimited history beyond Google's 16-month limit.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginSentinelProText: Sentinel Pro adds visit forecasts, public holidays and alarms per channel and conversion rate to the free Sentinel, plus a watchdog that speaks up when Sentinel itself stops.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginTrackingRouterText: Keep every website in its own profile and add a shared profile with continuous sessions: one tracking request, copied on the server to the sites you allow.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginTrackingSpamScoreText: Spots bot traffic by how whole groups of visits behave, shows it per network and blocks it while tracking, server-side.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginVisitJourneyText: A funnel with no presets: Visit Journey shows, for every goal and every order, which steps really came before it: pages, events, other goals and the channel the visit came through, as an interactive flow chart in Matomo.

FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreBasis: %1$s of %2$s campaign visits with clean values
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreDocumentation: The share of campaign visits whose campaign name (and source and medium, when Marketing Campaigns Reporting is active) is clean. Visits that Matomo grouped as "Others" cannot be checked and are not part of the basis.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreFieldsAll: Checked fields: campaign name, source and medium.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreMetricDocumentation: Share of campaign visits with clean values in percent. Without campaign visits that can be checked there is no score.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.MetricScoreMediumDocumentation: Share of the campaign visits with a clean medium, in percent; a missing medium counts as not clean. Only with Marketing Campaigns Reporting.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.MetricScoreNameDocumentation: Share of the campaign visits with a clean campaign name, in percent.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.MetricCheckedVisitsDocumentation: The campaign visits the score is based on: all campaign visits except those in rows grouped as "Others" and those without known values.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.MetricPreviousScoreDocumentation: The Campaign Score of the period before, in percent, for comparison.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.MetricScoreSourceDocumentation: Share of the campaign visits with a clean source, in percent; a missing source counts as not clean. Only with Marketing Campaigns Reporting.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreNoData: No campaign visits in this period.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreNoDataHint: Campaign visits come from links with mtm_ or utm_ campaign parameters. Choose another period, or check that your campaign links carry these parameters.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreShowLastPeriod: Show the last period with campaign visits
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreNoneChecked: None of the campaign visits in this period could be checked.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreUnchecked: %s campaign visits could not be checked (rows grouped as "Others", masked values, or visits from before Marketing Campaigns Reporting was activated).
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingAcceptedDescription: One value per line, written exactly as in the report. These values count as clean and are no longer shown as findings. Admins can also mark a value as correct directly in the findings table.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingMediumsDescription: One medium per line. Campaign Score shows a campaign medium outside this list as unusual. The default list holds the mediums that Feinwerk Channel Grouping assigns to a channel. Empty the field and save to go back to the default list.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSiteMediumsTitle: Own list of usual mediums (replaces the general list)
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingExtraMediumsDescription: One medium per line. They count as usual for this website in addition to the list that applies (this website's own list or the general one). Admins can also add an unusual medium directly from the findings table.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingNamePatternDescription: Optional. A regular expression every campaign name should match, for example ^[0-9]{4}- for names that start with a year. Empty: no pattern.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSeparatorDescription: The character that separates words in campaign values. A value with the other character is a finding. With "Either", only values that mix both are.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSiteMediumsDescription: One medium per line for this website. Empty: the list of the general settings applies.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSiteNamePatternDescription: Optional. A regular expression for the campaign names of this website. Empty: the pattern of the general settings applies.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSourceAliasesDescription: Treat common other spellings of large platforms as the same source, for example fb and m.facebook.com as facebook.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingTypoHintsDescription: List values that differ by one or two letters, such as newsleter and newsletter. These hints do not lower the score.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SitesLimited: Showing the %s websites with the most visits.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SparklineRange: Score of the last periods: from %1$s to %2$s
